terms.gloss: a chore, a day’s set task
terms.comment: Anciently a day’s weight of wool to spin.

sources: Lewis & Short: pensum

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. clean house, clean up, tidy up, broom: dustpan, garbage, trash, garbage can, waste basket. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 38, 39, 290, 292, 307, 320, 401, 404.
